verdict.rationale: GrowthBook supports leaving through several routes: it is open source and self-hostable with your own MongoDB, it offers a full REST API for programmatic access to app data, and it is warehouse-native, so experiment data stays in your own warehouse. OpenFeature support means switching providers only requires changing the provider bootstrap, not flag calls. However, nothing documents a dedicated full-account export in open formats, and exportable audit logs are only listed in a higher pricing tier. Missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk export of all flags, experiments and metrics in open formats, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe found 404s), and hands-on corroboration of a migration off the platform.
